trajectory_summary: The call opens with an unresolved feasibility question, moves through a smooth and cooperative verify section with genuine rapport touches, then stalls at the finish line when an in-person appointment format surprises the customer and collides with his travel schedule. The rep never locks a day or time; the call ends on a vague promise to follow up after the customer sends his bill and checks his own calendar.
outcome_dispute: This should not be tagged as a clean booked or tentative appointment. No date or time was set -- the rep states 'I'll just look out for your email, and then we can kinda just go from there' (05:44), which is a callback/pending-contact outcome, not a scheduled appointment. The customer explicitly deferred: 'I should have some availability at some point next week' (05:37) with no day or time attached.

Stating the format early, before offering times, removes this friction point entirely.
